definitions.gloss: sailing ship; sailboat; vessel propelled by sails
definitions.explanation: A ship or boat that uses sails to harness wind power for propulsion. Can refer to anything from small sailboats to large historical sailing vessels.

examples.japanese: {帆船|はんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{港|みなと}→港：01512_minato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}った→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: A sailing ship entered the port.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{帆船|はんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: I built a model of a large sailing ship.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{帆船|はんせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{日本海|にほんかい}→日本海：30773_nihonkai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|い}き{来|き}していた→行き来する：22992_ikikisuru⟧。
examples.english: In the Edo period, many sailing ships traveled back and forth across the Sea of Japan.

notes:
Composed of {帆|ほ} (sail) + ⟦{船|せん}→船：09875_sen⟧ (ship). The reading はんせん uses the on'yomi for both characters. The word {帆|ほ} alone means 'sail' and appears in expressions like {帆|ほ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{張|は}る→張る：12583_haru⟧ (to set sail).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {帆船|はんせん}レース: sailing race
- {帆船|はんせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧: model sailing ship
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧{帆船|はんせん}: large sailing vessel
- {帆船|はんせん}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧: age of sail

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ヨット→ヨット：00428_yotto⟧: yacht — modern recreational sailboat
- ⟦{汽船|きせん}→汽船：24661_kisen⟧: steamship — ship powered by steam engine
- {船舶|せんぱく}: vessel — formal general term for ships and boats
